Check before you pay

You’re leaving NaijaOuting for a link we haven’t confirmed as the official seller.

Only pay through a real ticket site or the organiser. Never pay into a personal bank account or a stranger’s DM. If something feels off, tap “Looks like a scam” on the event.

Import events

1. Spreadsheet

CSV or Excel, one event per row, or a zip holding the sheet and its flyers. A posts.csv of Instagram posts works too: Claude reads the flyers for you. The events.csv and the results zips from your flyer script work as they are.

2. Flyers (optional)

Pick the flyer pictures, or a zip of the flyers folder. Each is matched to its row by file name.

FlyerEventDatesCategoryCityVenueEntryCheck
Choose a spreadsheet to see a preview here. Nothing goes live until you press Publish.

Find flyers

1. Search Instagram

Type what you’re looking for. Pick the hashtags, copy the command and run it in your naija-flyers folder.

Or use a ready-made plan. “Every category” searches all 23 categories every day within your 30 a week; the others go deeper on one area if you have slots spare or a second Instagram account.

Click a hashtag to leave it out of the search, or ✕ to remove it. A hashtag counts as used only after the script has searched it and you load that folder here. Searching the same one again within 7 days doesn’t use another slot. Instagram only gives posts from the last 24 hours, so search once a day.

2. Load the results

Each run makes a zip like found/2026-11-02_194818.zip. Choose it here. You can load several, one after another.

3. Accounts to watch

Promoters you spot in the results. Add them to your watch list so every run checks them.

Nothing goes live from here. Selected flyers open in Import, where you check them and press Publish.
